# Area Development

> Area Development Magazine is the leading resource for business executives on site selection, facility planning, and workforce development decisions.

Area Development serves corporate real estate professionals, economic development consultants, and business executives through its flagship magazine, conference series, and networking forums. The publication covers critical topics in corporate relocation, site selection strategy, and regional economic development across major U.S. markets.

## Key Topics

- Site Selection
- Economic Development
- Corporate Real Estate
- Consultants Forum
- Facility Planning
- Workforce Development
- Conference & Events
- Business Networking
- Real Estate Executives
- Professional Development
- B2B Marketing
- Media & Advertising
- Regional Development

## Core Resources

- [Area Development Homepage](https://www.areadevelopment.com): Main portal for Area Development Magazine covering site selection, facility planning, and workforce development for business executives

## Consultants Forum & Events

- [Area Development Consultants Forum](https://www.areadevelopment.com/consultantsforum): Consultants forum and conference series for economic development professionals featuring Spring, Fall, and Women's forums at premium venues

## Advertising & Media Opportunities

- [Area Development Media Kit](https://mediakit.areadevelopment.com): Comprehensive media kit for Area Development Magazine advertising and sponsorship opportunities targeting real estate and economic development professionals
